reviews.text:
Please give yourself the opportunity to consider living elsewhere.

My daughter resided at Vela (Plan A) for 18 months. I am a retired real estate broker, and my husband served as a maintenance director for a hospital. Together, we have decades of experience with buildings, security, tenant relations, repairs, and property management.

Our experience at Vela has been consistently stressful, to the point that the lease was terminated six months before the end of the contract.

Management will likely respond to this review with polished language aimed at discrediting our account. I simply invite you to use your own discernment and consider the following points, all of which we experienced firsthand:

• Repair requests were routinely closed without resolution as the handling of closure / completion of work orders are handled from the management's side. Many issues had to be submitted multiple times, including a shower temperature control locked at an extremely hot setting, making it unusable.

• Four bedbug treatments were administered. These included preventive and reactive interventions after visible insects and nests were discovered in the bedroom. We were later informed that a neighboring unit had been struggling with an infestation, and that the unit is now vacant.

• Communication from management is inconsistent. Notices of entry were frequently delivered with only a few hours’ warning, even when more notice could reasonably have been provided. Although the bedbug situation was handled with urgency, the communication around treatments was often last-minute—for example, being given only 20 minutes to vacate the unit for a 6–8 hour extermination because the technician became available.

• Privacy breaches occurred.
On one occasion, the unit door was unlocked and a leasing agent entered unannounced with prospective tenants for a showing—while we were working from home. Another time, a planned entry by management left the door unlocked for several hours overnight.

• Staff turnover is unusually high.
Over 18 months, several maintenance managers came and went. On their last day, one openly stated they could not continue working for the company. Another admitted, regretfully, that financial targets were prioritized over tenant well-being.

Our rent was always paid on time, and continues to be, yet we chose to live elsewhere for the final two months before the lease ended.

Security, peace of mind, and respect are worth far more than the cost of rent.

We lived at Vela for two years across two different apartments, and overall our experience was very positive. The building itself is modern and well maintained, and the maintenance team has always been responsive and kind whenever we needed help.
Like any long tenancy, we experienced a few challenges along the way, but what stood out to us was the professionalism and support of the management team. Even through management transitions, we always felt listened to, and recently, the team went out of their way to accommodate us at the end of our lease.
We’re leaving with good memories of our time here, and we appreciate the efforts of both management and staff for making Vela a comfortable place to call home.

Beware! Apartments are very nice and location is great, but management is disgusting. After more than four years of living here with parking included in my lease, management suddenly claimed there had been a “mistake” and demanded an extra $80 per month or that I move to a smaller spot. They gave me 24 hours to comply, threatening daily fines and towing, and refused to let the rental board (TAL) review the issue as is my right. The contract they sent didn’t match the terms we discussed, and when I declined to sign, they deactivated my garage access cards—trapping my cars in the garage and essentially holding me hostage until I agreed. This was an extremely stressful and coercive experience that showed a complete lack of professionalism and respect for tenant rights. I am taking legal action against them.

From the day I moved in to the day I left, Vela management ignored requests to fix basic necessities in the apartment, some dating back to the previous tenants, that were flagged upon move-in, and shortly thereafter. Not to mention, multiple violations regarding my safety and privacy were committed, followed by abysmal and ineffective communication by Vela management. After living at Vela for 18 months, my apartment was unlivable, and I had to break my lease 6 months early when all other solutions were denied by Plan A.

The numbers are more important than the health and safety of the tenants, and it shows. I have never felt more unsafe than living at Vela.

Life on top of the Vaudreuil/Dorion World….

We moved to the VELA IV building after leaving our longtime family home and … garden in nearby Kirkland.  Downsizing proved to be an enormous task but the views of the Lake of Two Mountains and even the City of Montreal in the far distance offered a totally different and welcome perspective on daily life.  Surrounded by any and all amenities and services one needs (including the new hospital at only a stone throw away) we found VELA a great place to re-settle.  No more garden upkeep, house maintenance or the soon upon us snow removal required.  Management—and particularly Myriam, the manager,  has been very understanding for our needs such as parking close to the elevators, storage facilities and others.  We are very happy campers!
